messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — PR #8421 (canary config + kv-warmup) is queued for the 22:00 UTC canary. Need a second reviewer before we cut. @Priya can you take a look? https://git.internal/r/8421 :eyes:
Priya: On it. Will run local smoke now, pinging @Sam for a quick perf glance.
Sam: I can do a quick skim. Saw one timing edge in kv-warmup where we spawn extra threads on long seqs — might add ~20ms p99.
Priya: Good catch. I pushed a tiny tweak to limit warmup concurrency. Patch: ```diff
- spawnWorkers(threads)
+ spawnWorkers(min(threads, 4))
```
Sam: That looks fine to me. Ran a microbench, p99 reduced. LGTM from my side. :thumbsup:
Taylor (deploy-bot): Scheduled canary deployment for PR #8421 at 22:00 UTC. Queue position: 3.
Jordan: Thanks. Reminder: we need 2x LGTM before 21:45 cutoff to avoid delaying the canary. Anyone else available to be second sign-off?
Priya: I left one comment about a log message, fixed it in 8421@patch-2 and force-pushed. Tests are green.
Sam: Re-reviewed the force-push, clean. second LGTM from me.
Jordan: Awesome — two LGTMs achieved at 21:48. Merging now and kicking the canary. Will watch metrics for 30m. :shipit:
Taylor (deploy-bot): PR #8421 merged by Jordan at 21:48 UTC. Canary deployment started.
